roles.drugs: Glucocorticoids: optional burst then taper; earlier is better (within 24 h beat 25–72 h in one small series); helps vestibular recovery on caloric testing, symptom benefit uncertain (Cochrane 2011: none shown; 2022 meta-analysis: some benefit in the acute phase); your table says first line
